blocks.html:
Golf Cart Vinyl Equipment Wrap

Looking forward to summer, relaxing around the campsite, or hitting the beach with friends. This golf cart was designed for fun. The graphics and colour were chosen to hide dirt and have the look of being hardwearing. The graphics team had fun creating this for the customer. No one else can claim they have a similarly styled golf cart. The images show the cart still missing a few parts like lights and other electronics. They were removed before delivering it to Vinyl Wrap Toronto by the owner as he was doing an upgrade on the golf cart.
These 6 wheeled golf carts are not too common, and the graphics applied ensures this is now definitely a one-of-a-kind. The customer was extremely pleased with the final look of the wrap. He was also happy about the vinyl lasting more than 5 years. Our installation crew advised the customer of the best ways to care for the wrap. We also always advise that if they want to remove the vinyl wrap, come to see us or another professional so no glue or residue is left behind.
Vinyl Wrap Toronto loves to wrap other items, not just cars or trucks. Click here to see more recreational wraps.

We also offer branded water bottles to help cool off during the summer heat. We can wrap almost any item you bring us.
